// ConnectionStrings: SECURITY: This file is tracked in Git and MUST NOT contain real credentials.
The local SQL Server uses Windows authentication (no password), which is why no
secret appears below. For any environment that uses SQL authentication, inject the
connection string through user-secrets or an environment variable and delete the
value here — a secret in this file is a secret in the repository history.
// CorsSettings: In Production this must list only real HTTPS origins. Wildcards are rejected at
startup by AddCorsPolicy — an AllowAnyOrigin here would let any site read
// Jwt: Jwt:Key has NO default on purpose. Supply it via, in order of preference:
The application refuses to start without it. A committed signing key lets anyone
with repository access mint tokens for any user, including SuperAdmin.
// MailSettings: MailSettings:Password is an SMTP credential and is never committed.
Set it via user-secrets or the MailSettings__Password environment variable.
// OtpSettings: OtpSettings:HashingSecret has NO default on purpose — the default in the previous
version of this file was committed, so it must be considered public. Rotate it via
user-secrets or OtpSettings__HashingSecret. It is used to derive the per-purpose OTP
HMAC key, so rotating it invalidates every outstanding OTP.

// ServiceAccountFilePath: Points at a gitignored google-drive-key.json. The service-account private key
grants Drive access and must never be committed.

// GoogleAuth: GoogleAuth:ClientId is a public identifier and is safe to commit, but it is left
empty here so each environment configures its own OAuth client.
